CORPORATE PROFILE                                                        公司簡介
SHOUGANG FUSHAN RESOURCES GROUP LIMITED                                  首鋼福山資源集團有限公司
is one of the most sizable integrated coking coal corporations in        為中國中西部最具規模之綜合焦煤企業之一。
CENTRAL-WESTERN CHINA.

Taking Shanxi Province as its major investment base, it is principally   以山西省作為主要投資基地，主要從事 焦煤開
engaged in MINING OF COKING COAL, PRODUCTION AND SALES                   採、原焦煤及精焦煤生產及銷售業務。
OF RAW AND CLEAN COKING COAL.

The Group has three premium operating coking coal mines and              本集團現有三座在產的優質焦煤礦及三座洗煤
three coal preparation plants.                                           廠。

COAL CHARACTERISTICS                                                            煤炭特徵

•    Located within the Lishi-Liulin mining area of Hedong                      •   位於河東煤田之離柳礦區，該區為中國優
     coalfield, one of China’s key reserve areas for high-quality                   質硬焦煤之主要儲量區域之一。
     hard coking coal.

•    Regarded as “panda coal” because of its scarcity and high                  •   由於其稀有性和高經濟價值，被譽為「熊貓
     economic value.                                                                煤」。

•    The Group’s coking coal is of particularly good quality due                •   本集團之焦煤發熱值高及焦結度強，加上
     to its high calorific value and caking index with low ash and                  灰份及硫份低，品質優越，使之非常適合
     sulfur content characteristics that are highly desirable for                   用於生產焦炭及鋼鐵。
     coke and steel making.

                 Wastewater            The Group’s primary sources of wastewater are domestic sewage and mine water.
                 treatment             We have built a domestic wastewater treatment station and a mine water treatment
                 廢水處理                  station at each operating mine, which is contracted and operated by professional
                                       third parties. In particular, the domestic wastewater treatment station adopts the
                                       advanced AO9+MBR10 method to ensure that all wastewater is reused for dust
                                       prevention, sprinkling and coal preparation. The mine water treatment station
                                       adopts techniques such as flocculation, sedimentation, filtration and ultrafiltration,
                                       allowing all treated water to be reused for dust prevention, sprinkling and
                                       coal washing. The remaining portion undergoes activated carbon filtration and
                                       ultrafiltration treatment to ensure compliance with discharge standards.
                                       本集團產出的廢水主要分為生活污水與礦井水兩大類。針對這兩類廢水，我們在每
                                       座在產礦均設立了專門的生活污水處理站與礦井水處理站，並委託專業第三方進行
                                       承包運營。生活污水處理站採用先進的AO9+MBR10處理工藝，確保處理後的廢水全
                                       部得到循環利用，主要用於井水防塵灑水和洗煤用水。礦井水處理站則通過絮凝、
                                       沉澱、過濾及超濾等工藝，將處理後的中水同樣復用於井下防塵灑水和洗煤用水，
                                       剩餘部分則經過活性炭過濾與超濾處理，確保達標排放。
                 Emission              The Group’s current emissions are unorganized dust and soot. To effectively
                 treatment             control unorganized dust, we have implemented comprehensive dust suppression
                 廢氣處理                  measures, including the installation of raw coal, clean coal, and gangue silos,
                                       enclosed coal storage sheds, enclosed conveyor bridges, and tire washing systems.
                                       For soot, dust collectors have been installed in screening workshops. Compared
                                       with the previous year, we have enhanced dust control by installing dust removal
                                       and gas-washing facilities in the intelligent dry processing workshop at Jinjiazhuang
                                       Coal Mine, as well as new dust removal systems in the intelligent dry processing
                                       workshop at Zhaiyadi Coal Mine.
                                       本集團的廢氣主要分為無組織粉塵和有組織粉塵兩類。為有效處置無組織粉塵，我
                                       們配備了原煤、精煤和矸石筒倉、封閉式儲煤棚、封閉式運輸棧橋及輪胎沖洗裝置
                                       等設施。對於有組織粉塵，我們則在篩分車間安裝了除塵器。與上年度相比，金家
                                       莊煤礦智能乾選車間內增設了除塵洗氣設施，寨崖底煤礦智能乾選車間內增設除塵
                                       洗氣設施。

                Solid waste            The Group’s general solid waste primarily consists of coal gangue from
                disposal               underground mining operations, while hazardous waste mainly includes waste
                固體廢棄物處理                engine oil. In solid waste management, we emphasize source control by optimizing
                                       production processes to reduce raw material consumption and minimize waste
                                       generation. Concurrently, we strengthen operational oversight of intelligent
                                       dry separation equipment to minimize coal content in gangue discharge and
                                       actively promote the use of recyclable materials. Following categorized collection
                                       and treatment, all gangue is transported to designated disposal sites for valley
                                       filling and land reclamation, ensuring both efficient resource utilization and
                                       environmental protection.
                                       本集團一般固體廢棄物主要來自井下回採產出的煤矸石，有害廢棄物主要為廢機
                                       油。在固體廢棄物管理方面，本集團從源頭加強控制，通過優化生產工藝流程，減
                                       少原材料消耗及廢棄物產生量。同時，我們加強對智能乾選設備的運行監管，以減
                                       少矸石帶煤現象，並積極推廣使用可循環利用材料。在實施分類收集與處理的基礎
                                       上，我們將本集團生產過程中產生的矸石全部運輸至矸石場進行填溝造地處理，以
                                       實現資源的合理利用與環境的有效保護。

Risk Governance Structure                                                      風險管治架構

The Group’s risk governance structure is based on a “Three Lines               本集團以三道防線模式為基礎來支援董事會對
of Defense” model, with oversight by the Board on an ongoing                   風險管理系統的持續監督，並透過審核委員會
basis and is reviewed by the Audit Committee and subsequently                  審議的檢討結果向董事會匯報風險管理系統是
reported to the Board on the effectiveness of the risk management              否有效。

                                                     2022 and 2023. Therefore, on 23 September 2022, the Company and

                                                     Purchase Agreement to revise the annual caps and to extend the term
                                                     for one year ending on 31 December 2024 in order to comply with the

                                                     本集團於其一般及日常業務過程中自二零一零年起向首鋼集團及╱或

                                                     下福山產品之市場價格已大幅上漲，董事會預期，截至二零二二年及
                                                     二零二三年十二月三十一日止年度，二零二一年總買賣協議項下之原

     3.9 Borrowing costs                                                     3.9 借貸成本

          General and specific borrowing costs that are directly                直接源自收購、建築或生產合資格資
          attributable to the acquisition, construction or                      產之一般及特定借貸成本於完成及籌
          production of a qualifying asset are capitalised during               備資產以作其擬定用途或銷售所需期
          the period of time that is required to complete and                   間內資本化。合資格資產指需要大量
          prepare the asset for its intended use or sale. Qualifying            時間籌備以作擬定用途或銷售之資產。
          assets are assets that necessarily take a substantial
          period of time to get ready for their intended use or sale.

          Other borrowing costs are expensed in the period in                   其他借貸成本於其產生之期間內支銷。
          which they are incurred.

     3.10 Provisions                                                         3.10 撥備

          Provisions are recognised when the Group has a present                當本集團因過往事件須承擔現有法律
          legal or constructive obligation as a result of past                  或推定責任，而解除責任將很可能需
          events, it is probable that an outflow of resources will              要資源流出，且有關金額已可作可靠
          be required to settle the obligation and the amount can               估算時會確認撥備，惟不會就日後之
          be reliably estimated. Provisions are not recognised for              經營虧損確認任何撥備。
          future operating losses.

          Where there are a number of similar obligations, the                  倘出現多項類似責任，是否需要資源
          likelihood that an outflow will be required in settlement             流出以解除責任乃經考慮整體責任類
          is determined by considering the class of obligations as a            別後釐定。即使就同類責任中任何一
          whole. A provision is recognised even if the likelihood of            項出現資源流出之可能性不大，仍會
          an outflow with respect to any one item included in the               確認撥備。
          same class of obligations may be small.

          Provisions are measured at the present value of                       撥備按管理層對於報告期末預期須償
          management’s best estimate of the expenditure required                付現有責任之支出之最佳估計之現值
          to settle the present obligation at the end of the                    計量。用於釐定現值之貼現率為反映
          reporting period. The discount rate used to determine                 當時市場對金錢時間值及負債特定風
          the present value is a pre-tax rate that reflects current             險之評估之稅前利率。隨時間流逝而
          market assessments of the time value of money and the                 增加之撥備確認為利息開支。
          risks specific to the liability. The increase in the provision
          due to the passage of time is recognised as interest
          expense.

     3.19 Current and deferred income tax                                      3.19 即期及遞延所得稅

          and generate taxable income. Management periodically                   用稅務法例詮釋所規限之情況定期評
          evaluates positions taken in tax returns with respect to               估報稅表之狀況，並考慮稅務機關是

          interpretation and considers whether it is probable that a             集團根據最可能的金額或預期值來衡

          The Group measures its tax balances either based on the                可以更好地預測不確定性的解決方法。

          assessments of the time value of money and the risks                          計。本集團考慮礦井發展計劃、礦場
          specific to the liability. The Group considers the factors                    區域地質結構及儲備量等因素以確定
          including development plan of the mines, the geological                       開展復墾及礦井關閉工作的範圍、數

          determine the scope, amount and timing of reclamation                         本集團的判斷及估計負債可能會與所
          and mine closure works to be performed. Determination                         產生實際支出有所不同。本集團採用
          of the effect of these factors involves judgements from                       的貼現率亦可能被改變，以反映貨幣

          be different from the actual expenditure to be incurred.                      出現的變動，如市場借款利率及通脹
          The discount rate used by the Group may also be altered                       率的變動。由於估計發生變化（如礦井
